title: geocode_addresses inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the analysis/geoprocessing batch geocode tool (advertised name honua_geocode_addresses). Resolves up to 100 freeform addresses in one call, returning one result per input in input order ({input, ok, location?, score?, error?}); a failed address surfaces per item without failing the batch. First step of the CSV-of-addresses workflow: geocode here, then load the coordinates with ingest_dataset and publish the table with publish_service. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

addresses.description: Freeform single-line addresses to geocode, in the order results should be returned.

countryCodes.description: Optional comma-separated ISO 3166 country codes to restrict the search.

outSrid.description: Spatial reference (SRID/WKID) for returned coordinates (x=longitude, y=latitude order). Defaults to 4326 (WGS84 lon/lat).
